findings.text: the budget-hold arm re-spells the hoisted verdict as `alive is not True` instead of using `process_gone`; the truth table is identical (alive is None or False), so this is an idiom nit, not a defect, but the classification-order comment at :1340-1342 promises a single hoisted liveness verdict and the function now carries two spellings of the same test.

the done_when asked the implementation manifest to quote the invariant comment verbatim ('quote the comment at recovery.py:1334-1337 in your manifest'); the stored manifest at ~/.config/reckon/crew/manifests/liveness-outranks-classification.md records the reproduction and the change but never quotes the comment. The substance is present — I independently confirmed the defect reproduces at base and the fix resolves it — so this is a citation gap in the evidence record, not a defect in the repair.

justifications.durability: a regression that reintroduces any unreadable-for-live reading fails the gate — I proved two of the nine cases fail at base and pass at head, and the dead control test_a_gone_process_keeps_the_invalid_wait_unreadable at :199 keeps the incomplete-wait reading alive for a gone process so the fix is a reservation, not a removal.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's falsifier is ranged exactly as written over the seven manifest states in tests/test_live_process_outranks_classification.py:152-178, and I reproduced it independently: the invalid-wait and refusal-text cases fail at base 976dba6 (row reads unreadable where running is required, recovery.py:1459 at base had no liveness guard) while the same file passes 9/9 at the reviewed head, and every numeric claim in the record (228 insertions over 2 files, 261 vs 252 with the identical single pre-existing test_mcp_recovery.py failure at both revisions) verifies.
justifications.fit: the change follows the surrounding idiom, keeps the refusal text on the running row through the existing manifest_error channel, and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid, but the hoisted verdict is re-spelled inline at reckon/crew/recovery.py:1485 (elif budget_hold and alive is not True) where the hoisting comment promises one verdict.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:1352 hoists one liveness verdict process_gone = alive is not True above the chain and both unreadable-producing arms consult it (the incomplete-wait arm at :1472, the refuse-to-parse manifest arm at :1619), making the invariant the base comment at :1334-1338 stated true across every manifest state a live run can reach.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --name-only confirms commit 882012ef touches only reckon/crew/recovery.py and tests/test_live_process_outranks_classification.py and 8f7e3fd8 only docs/evidence/archive/crew-observability-truth-landed.html and docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html, exactly the four declared write paths, with the pre-existing mcp_recovery failure correctly reported as a follow-on rather than triaged.
